current_decision.message: Selected the 'fast' profile of esp32_bmp280_v1 to meet the requested 2.2k pull-ups and 400 kHz I2C bus speed, using the published default envelope for other parameters.

clauses.text: Fit the approved 2.2-kilohm bus pull-ups and run I2C at 400000 Hz on the pressure controller;
clauses.reason: The request to fit 2.2-kilohm bus pull-ups and run I2C at 400000 Hz matches the 'fast' profile which uses 2.2k pull-ups and supports 400kHz operation.
The request to use the published defaults elsewhere is supported by using the 'fast' profile's published operating envelope for other parameters.
